content.comment_body: Is it possible to use more than two analog input (AI) values in one message text?
Direct display only supports a maximum of two AI values. However, if you connect them after the AI's analog amplifier, it's possible to show more. This allows you to display more than two values.
Alternatively, you can go to the start menu. See the attached file.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing the product's restriction of showing more than two AI values in a single message text. While direct display has this limitation, users mention possible workarounds for displaying additional values, which is important when summarizing multiple sensor inputs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the product to permit displaying more than two AI values in a single message text to allow for more flexible and comprehensive data presentation.
